verdict.rationale: Probes show no llms.txt and no markdown docs mirror (both 404). LocalAI does document its own machine-readable discovery surfaces on every server: an "API Discovery & Instructions" page covering /.well-known/localai.json, /api/instructions and a Swagger tree, plus a full Swagger 2.0 spec in the repo, which an agent could be pointed at. This is partial agent-oriented documentation, not the llms.txt-style site docs the story names. Missing for 10: an llms.txt file, markdown or agent-readable versions of the docs site, evidence that /api/instructions content is written for agents, and hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these endpoints.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: The same "API Discovery & Instructions" page documents the unauthenticated discovery endpoints (/.well-known/localai.json, /api/instructions, and the /swagger tree).
The server advertises it at runtime: the documented /.well-known/localai.json discovery response lists "swagger": "/swagger/index.html".
